items.title: One customer view

faqs.question: Which POS systems do you integrate?
faqs.answer: Common POS platforms (Shopify POS, Square, Lightspeed, Odoo, and others) — connected to your online store so data flows both ways.

faqs.question: Will inventory stay accurate?
faqs.answer: Yes — stock syncs in real time so you avoid overselling and keep one source of truth across channels.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, and configurations. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
